name: Mufin Green Finance Limited
summary: Mufin Green Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financing and investing services in India. The company offers Mediclaim insurance premium financing, salary-linked loans to government employees, electric vehicles and solar ecosystem financing, and loans to corporates and MSMEs. It also provides operating or financial lease services to fleet operators for vehicles, including two-, three-, and four-wheelers, as well as charging infra and battery swapping.
